scenes.subtitle: The classic practice drill.
lines: This lesson teaches the classic practice drill for changing chords.
Spend one minute on each pair, moving smoothly from one to the next.

scenes.heading: One-minute changes
points: Pick two chords and switch quickly
Count your changes and improve daily
lines: The one-minute change is a classic drill: pick two chords and switch between them as many times as you can in one minute, aiming for a clean strum every time.
Count your changes and try to beat your record each day.
It's a fun way to build speed and confidence.
Let's practice changing between G, C and D major.
Strum each chord once, clearly and evenly, to build smooth transitions.
Let's practice these four chords: E minor, C major, G major and D major.
They're the building blocks of thousands of songs, and changing between them is a great way to start playing.
